reflections.summary: Lost because Zard-Y's sun offense ran through a brought four where three mons (Metagross, Mamoswine, Serperior) are Fire-weak: Overheat OHKO'd Mega Metagross on entry and Solar Beam OHKO'd Mamoswine, while Garganacl's repeated Wide Guard blanked every Rock Slide so Aerodactyl—the only mon that resists Fire and threatens Zard 4x SE—was ground down by Salt Cure and finished off. Preview plan was flawed: Mega-evolving Metagross straight into Zard-Y and relying on spread Rock Slide played directly i
reflections.adjustment: Game 2: build around Aerodactyl as the Zard answer—preserve its Focus Sash by keeping it away from Salt Cure, Taunt Garganacl (Aero 200 Spe outspeeds) to shut off Wide Guard, and on Wide Guard turns attack with single-target Meteor Mash/Ice Punch which Wide Guard can't block; double-target Zard-Y to force switches or KO it from <=58% with Rock Slide, and never Mega-evolve Metagross while Zard is on the field.
reflections.notebook: Series vs sun squad (0-1). Opp roster Zard-Y/Venu/Garga/Pult/Goodra-H/Clef; G1 showed Zard+Venu+Garga, 4th unrevealed. SPEED: Pult <=213 > Aero 200 > Serperior 181 > Zard-Y <=167 > M-Meta 130-162 > Venu <=132 (sun x2) > Goodra/Clef <=112 > Mamo 102 > Garga <=87. CORE PROBLEM: 3 of our 4 (Meta/Mamo/Serperior) are Fire-weak, so Zard-Y is the raid boss—Overheat OHKO'd Mega Meta through 172 Def, Solar Beam OHKO'd Mamo; only Aero resists Fire and its RS is 4x SE vs Zard, KOing from <=58%. OPP TENDENCIES: Garga defaults to Wide Guard every turn vs spread moves (chained 3 straight; chain resets when it uses Salt Cure), Leftovers recovery; Zard stays in clicking Overheat/Solar Beam even at -4 SpA. GARGA: Purifying Salt blocks burn/para/sleep NOT Taunt; Wide Guard fails vs single-target Mash/Ice Punch; Body Press 2x SE vs Mamo; Salt Cure 2x SE vs Aero. ZARD: punish Solar Beam charge turns once sun ends. VENU: no Protect; sun Weather Ball is Fire. GOODRA-H: Sap Sipper—never use Grass; EQ 2x SE. CLEF: Unaware; Follow Me eats single-target not spread; Mash 2x SE. PULT: may outspeed Aero; Glare hits Ghosts; Ice Shard 2x SE vs it. OURS: Mega Tough Claws boosts Mash/Ice Punch not EQ; Aero Sash only works from full HP; RS spread beats Follow Me. G2 PLAN: Aero-centric—Taunt Garga to kill Wide Guard, single-target attacks on WG turns, double-target Zard, keep Aero Sash intact, don't Mega Meta into Zard.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Charizard Y with Garganacl was the ideal plan, as Wide Guard completely shut down the opponent's heavy reliance on spread moves (Rock Slide / Earthquake) while Sun powered up Charizard to eliminate Mamoswine and Mega Metagross.
reflections.adjustment: Anticipate the opponent adjusting to Aerodactyl using Taunt on Garganacl or setting Tailwind rather than spamming Rock Slide, so be ready to attack Aerodactyl directly or pivot Hisuian Goodra/Venusaur in if Garganacl gets Taunted.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tendencies: heavily relies on spread move spam (Rock Slide / Earthquake) with Aerodactyl and physical attackers. Aerodactyl carries Focus Sash + Taunt, which is their main counterplay to Garganacl's Wide Guard. Plan: keep Garganacl + Charizard-Y lead core if they re-lead physical/spread threats, but prioritize punishing or preventing Taunt on Garganacl.
